cues: Vermicomposting turns organic waste into rich manure using earthworms.
But only one kind of earthworm will do.
Epigeic worms live in the surface litter and eat and breed fast: perfect.
Anecic worms dig deep vertical burrows, and endogeic worms eat soil; neither suits a shallow bin.
The standard species is Eisenia fetida, the red wiggler.
